collection.description: Two cooks insist their family soups taste completely different.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (cook1) and (cook2), two cooks, insist their family soups taste completely different.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The cooks discover they used the same ingredients and burst out laughing.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One cook prefers the other's soup despite the recipes matching.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The guests disagree cheerfully, and both pots are emptied.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The guests ask for more bread instead of choosing a winner.
